name: Cape of the Mountebank
summary: A cape that lets you cast Dimension Door once a day, leaving a puff of smoke.

stats.effect:
This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast *{ref:spell/dimension-door}* as a {ref:glossary/magic} action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is {ref:glossary/lightly-obscured} by that smoke until the end of your next turn.
